alerts.title: Decoy Canary File Accessed
alerts.description: Simulated actor on Employee Workstation accessed monitored decoy document (Executive Salary Decoy).
evidence: Target asset 'Executive Salary Decoy' (decoy-payroll-file) is a registered deception tripwire.
Beacon fired from source endpoint employee-pc-01.
Zero legitimate business access patterns permit opening this canary document.
recommended_actions: Isolate host employee-pc-01 from internal subnet.
Revoke active sessions and Kerberos TGTs for the current user profile.
Audit file access logs on adjacent storage nodes.

alerts.title: Honey-Token Credential Infiltration Attempt
alerts.description: Planted honey-token (Planted AWS Admin Honey-Token) used in lateral authentication from Corporate File Share.
evidence: Honey-token 'Planted AWS Admin Honey-Token' (honey-credential-01) has zero authorized production usage.
Originating node file-server-01 executed lateral pivot using stolen token.
Signature correlates with automated memory-dumping / credential-harvesting tools.
recommended_actions: Immediately blacklist and cycle all credentials in the affected credential vault.
Quarantine file-server-01 and trigger emergency memory forensics.
Enforce MFA challenge on all downstream privileged service accounts.
